profile.headline: Software Engineer @ JPMorgan Chase | Distribution @ Plantcon Intl
profile.summary: Texas A&M University Class of 2020 Graduate with a BA in Management Information Systems and Cybersecurity Minor. Software engineer with strong background in event logistics management, leadership empowerment, non-profit work, diversity awareness, and education initiatives.

positions.title: Distribution Lead
positions.description:
Leads inventory maintenance and materials procurement/transportation necessary for all convention operations
Coordinates A/V set up and merchandise ordering with stakeholder teams
Manages volunteer teams on vendor set up and decoration/signage during day-of convention operations
Develops internal technology workplace solutions and tools for streamlined cross-collaboration across departments, mainly through Google Appscript and Google Suite

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Python developer for post-trade data distribution downstream and migration activities
- Technical Release Manager for global developer teams, managing all code releases and verifying production-readiness of changes/Jira hygiene
- Designs and develops applications within Rates/FX/Commodities Technology and builds/migrates core feeds essential to operations on strategic platforms for business stakeholders
- Works alongside London, Glasgow, and Asia-Pacific technology teams in Agile, CI/CD, multi-year projects focused on Legacy Platform retirement, modernization, and innovation
- Coordinates migration efforts from legacy on-prem platform to cloud-based downstream data platform solutions
- Acts as Release Manager for global teams, managing all version control practices while tracking SDLC, Jira progression/metrics, and Agile methodology adherence as acting Scrum Master

company.name: Union of North American Vietnamese Student Associations (UNAVSA)

positions.title: President
positions.description:
Oversaw all business proceedings and strategic direction of the organization and acted as lead governing officer for VSA organizations and associated 501(c)(3) non-profits across North America
Managed active professional and leadership development of organization leadership and North American Vietnamese community
Primary stakeholder in facilitation of annual flagship 4-day professional development conference held for students and young professionals across North America, featuring up to 500 attendance annually

positions.title: Executive Director
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Spearheading flagship professional development conference primarily serving hundreds of Vietnamese American students and early professionals across North America as primary project manager.
Oversees budget planning, community outreach, and global partnerships with sponsors, keynote speakers, and other partnering 501(c)(3) non-profits.

positions.title: Associate Director
positions.description:
Supported executive director in spearheading flagship professional development conference primarily serving hundreds of Vietnamese American students and early professionals across North America as secondary project manager.
Directed materials procurement and logistical coordination with global partners

positions.title: Logistics Director
positions.description:
Oversaw logistics management and materials procurement for flagship professional development conference primarily serving Vietnamese American students and early professionals across North America.
Primary contact directing all scheduling and coordination with partnering organizations, speakers, and stakeholders.

company.name: Union of Vietnamese Student Associations of the Southern Region

positions.title: President
positions.description:
Spearheaded event planning efforts as primary project manager of bi-annual flagship events, including but not limited to leadership development summer camps (150+ attendance) and professional development conferences (300+ attendance).
Dictated overall structure, functionality, and vision for the organization. Ensured effective action in governing and supporting all partnering community organizations across Texas, Oklahoma, and Arkansas. Managed direction and responsibility management among the selected Cabinet Board. Reviews yearly funding, investments, and budgeting for event programming throughout the year. Audits financial records and ensures good legal standing as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
Oversaw website restructuring and maintenance, utilizing AWS backend and Wordpress as base structure to build registration and launch portals via relevant plugins.

positions.title: Internal Vice President
positions.description: Oversaw Intercollegiate Council of Representatives between all partner schools (11) in the UVSA South network across Texas, Oklahoma, and Arkansas. Assists with development of Cabinet Staff activities and projects throughout the year, including but not limited to fundraising for UNAVSA's annual Collective Philanthropy Project and engagment with its Project 2020 initiative. Provided executive oversight for large scale events, including the annual UVSA South Leadership Summit for professional development (200+ attendance), the annual UVSA South Camp Legacy for leadership and networking development (100+ attendance), and the annual Vietnamese Cultural Showcase (100+ attendance) for community cultural enrichment. Acted as second-in-command when the president is unavailable to fulfill certain functions. Managed engagement and outreach programs with multicultural student communities across the region.

positions.title: Programming Director
positions.description: Oversaw the scheduling of programming throughout entirety of Camp Legacy 5. Managed committee in charge of audio/video technology for the weekend and outreached to presenters and established workshops covering topics on leadership and professional development, cultural education, etc.. Ensured smooth organization, communication, and transitions throughout the event.

positions.title: General Staff
positions.description:
Community Service and Outreach Committee - Outreached to external organizations and VSAs about UVSA South's mission and helped establish joint cultural programs. Helped create community service initiatives within the UVSA South community and raised awareness for service causes.
Marketing and Media Committee - Helped manage public relations affairs and scheduled social media posts covering the different programs within the organization as well as cultural and civic awareness. Supervised creative media projects and filmed, edited, and produced cultural culinary webshow.

positions.title: Information Technology Associate
positions.description:
●	Consulted with client companies in providing technical solutions for major IT projects
●	Specialized in providing HTML, Python, and Full Stack Java developmental support
●	Provided preproduction test case solutions and optimized heavy load SQL querying via Snowflake

positions.title: OTR Area Manager, Delivery Ops
positions.description:
- Engaged with Delivery Service Partners and monitored safety and on road metrics to ensure safe on road behavior and productive completion of all delivery routes by delivery fleet of 250+ associates
- Oversaw Return to Station operations and debriefing DAs, taking note of any barriers preventing route completion and partnering with DSPs and Under the Roof operations to remove them as soon as possible
- Managed ground logistics for Last Mile of deliveries -- encompassing everything traveling from delivery stations to the hands of the customers

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: Managed documents and student files, logged forms and updated records in student database.

positions.title: IT Applications - Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
Developed, executed, and maintained testing scripts for business processes. Reported and documented bugs/anomalies via regression testing.
Automated customer identification reporting for finance department, saving on average 60 work hours every month.
